acceptance: The owner approved the design recorded here.
Refresh pull requests carry machine-checked evidence while staying under review.
context: Filed 2026-11-20 from the adversarial review of the scale-factor and TPC-DI remediation work (PRs #4298-#4385 and benchbox-site #178-#210).
description:
## Problem
Baseline refresh pull requests rewrite tens of thousands of generated lines. #3534, #3669 and #3915 merged with bot reviews; #4004, #4090 and #4381 merged through owner stand-ins; scheduled #3928, #4066 and #4283 were never merged. The baseline stays a soundness path.

## Change
Design first: a `reproduce` command that rebuilds a refresh pull request's baseline from the artifacts its manifest names and reports byte identity and source-run provenance, run as a non-exempting check whose green result is the evidence for the owner's stand-in; a notification to the owner when a scheduled refresh pull request opens; and a refresh cadence. The provenance and byte-identity code written for #4385 may be reused after review.

## Decision gates
If the owner closes the redesign: the owner approves the design, the cadence and the notification channel before implementation. The baseline path stays in `.github/soundness-paths.txt` and out of `.github/inert-paths.txt`. No change to the 1.30 ratio or 360 s delta, to the normalizer, or to which tests are charged.

## Verification rubric
Pass: on a real refresh pull request the check reports byte identity and lists source runs; a tampered baseline fails it; the path manifests are unchanged; a scheduled refresh produces the notification.

## Additions from the item review
- The check verifies each artifact's run: ci.yml, `pull_request` event, this repository, a pull request merged into develop, at that pull request's final head; rejects a `generated_at` older than develop's baseline; and tolerates re-runs of source runs.
- Tamper cases that must fail: an artifact from an unmerged pull request, the refresh pull request's own run, and a rolled-back `generated_at`.

## Guardrails
- Any limit, default, threshold or label id or text is shown to the owner before it is committed. Briefs quote owner answers verbatim; questions to the owner carry no preselected answer.
- The implementer replies on review threads and leaves resolving them to the reviewer or the owner, unless the owner says otherwise (AGENTS.md asks agents to resolve benchbox-oracle threads on soundness paths; the owner has been asked which applies).
- Hosted writes (merge, close, disable or enable auto-merge, workflow dispatch, remote branch delete) only as the repository's close-out procedure or the owner's word for that pull request allows; never raw `gh pr merge` in core.
- No polling loop around `make pr-arm`, no `--no-verify`, no stand-in review unless the owner names the PR and head unprompted. Push only after `make pr-preflight` exits 0 on the exact head.
- No worktree takeover while another session may be working; no tracker write from a server that reports a stale version; never chain `git stash` with `git stash pop`.
- Heavy work runs only through `make heavy-run` or a lock-taking entry point, one run at a time.
- Status reports state only what merged and what was verified, with the evidence.
